description: Get a single CHIP by number. Looks first on main (merged) and also surfaces any open PRs proposing changes to the same number. Returns parsed front matter, abstract, source URL, and (with include_body=true) the full markdown body.

include_body.description: If true, include the full markdown body of the CHIP. Defaults to false.

number.description: CHIP number, e.g. 42 or "0042". Accepts the integer or a zero-padded string.

name: get_chip
